question_text: Find the mean deviation about the median for the data 4, 6, 9, 3, 10, 13, 2.

recall_prompt: Say how you would find the mean deviation about the median for seven numbers — what you do to the data first, how you pick the median, and what you average at the end.
insider_note: The data must be put in ascending order and the median stated before any deviation is taken — the middle of the unsorted list is 3, not the true median 6.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Median
steps.margin_note: First mark. The data is not in order, so sort it first. n = 7 is odd, so the median is the single middle value, the 4th of seven: 6.
lines: n = 7 is odd, so M = the middle (4th) value.

recall.must_convey: That the values are sorted, n = 7 is odd, and the median is the middle value 6.
accept: put the numbers in order two three four six nine ten thirteen, seven is odd so the median is the middle one, six
sort the data and take the fourth of the seven values, which is six
median is the middle value after sorting, six
ascending order lo pettite madhyalo unnadi six, adi median

steps.why: The median is the middle of the ORDERED data, so the sort is part of the method, not a preparation. With an odd n there is one middle value and no averaging.
common_mistakes: Taking the middle of the unsorted list (3, the 4th as given).
Averaging the 3rd and 4th values as if n were even.
Using the mean (47/7) instead of the median.

steps.label: Mean deviation
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Absolute deviations from 6, in the sorted order: 4, 3, 2, 0, 3, 4, 7. Sum 23, divide by n = 7. 23/7 = 3.2857…, written 3.29.

recall.must_convey: That the absolute deviations from 6 are 4, 3, 2, 0, 3, 4, 7, their sum 23 divided by 7 gives 3.29.
accept: take each number minus six without sign, add to twenty three, divide by seven, three point two nine
the absolute deviations from the median add to twenty three and twenty three by seven is three point two nine
mean deviation is sigma mod x i minus M by n equals twenty three by seven equals three point two nine
six nunchi deviations mod teesukoni add cheste twenty three, seven tho divide cheste three point two nine
the answer is three point two nine

steps.why: Mean deviation about the median is the average distance from the median. The absolute value keeps every distance positive; the median's own term is 0.
common_mistakes: Subtracting from the mean instead of from the median.
Dividing 23 by 6 (leaving out the zero term) instead of by n = 7.
